description: Source code for DETR object detection model and associated loss functions, post-processing, and model building functions.

classes.name: DETR
classes.description: Object detection model class implementing the DETR architecture with transformer backbone and auxiliary loss support.

classes.name: SetCriterion
classes.description: Loss computation class for DETR, including classification, bounding box, mask, and auxiliary losses.

classes.name: PostProcess
classes.description: Converts model outputs into COCO API format, scaling boxes to original image size.

classes.name: MLP
classes.description: Multi-layer perceptron used for bounding box regression.

methods.name: _set_aux_loss
methods.description: Creates auxiliary outputs for intermediate decoder layers.

methods.name: loss_labels
methods.description: Computes classification loss (cross-entropy) for predicted logits.

methods.name: loss_cardinality
methods.description: Computes the error in the number of predicted non-empty boxes for logging.

methods.name: loss_boxes
methods.description: Computes bounding box regression losses: L1 and GIoU.

methods.name: loss_masks
methods.description: Computes mask-related losses: focal loss and dice loss.

methods.name: get_loss
methods.description: Retrieves specific loss function and computes it.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the overall loss computation, including auxiliary losses if enabled.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs inference, converting raw model outputs into detection results with scaled bounding boxes.
